title: Cornerstone School · Grade 2 · Word Problems

items.question: Simran picked 24 red apples and 19 green apples from the orchard. How many apples did she pick in all?
There were 52 birds sitting on a tree. 26 birds flew away. How many birds are left on the tree?
There are 36 boys and 28 girls in the school playground. How many children are in the playground altogether?
Priya had 45 stickers. Her mother gave her 18 more stickers. Then she gave 12 stickers to her brother. How many stickers does Priya have now?
Aryan had 70 marbles. He gave 38 marbles to his friend. How many marbles does Aryan have now?
A baker made 45 muffins in the morning and 27 more muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
A shopkeeper had 64 balloons. He sold 27 of them. How many balloons are left?
Kabir collected 33 seashells on Monday and 29 seashells on Tuesday. How many seashells did he collect in all?
A farmer had 80 mangoes. He sold 35 mangoes in the morning and bought 20 more mangoes in the afternoon. How many mangoes does he have now?
A library had 58 story books. 23 books were borrowed by students. How many story books are left in the library?

_note: Page 2 entered 2026-09-20: questions 7-10 were on every child's scan from the start and had no slots, so four answers per child - twenty-four in all - were dropped on every import. Question 9 is two-step across two operations, which no expression on this paper can carry, so it holds its answer and no predictions.
